items.title: DeepSeek just open-sourced its inference engine
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 开源其推理引擎，提升模型部署效率与透明性
items.why_zh: 属推理优化技能点，可学习高性能推理架构设计、内存管理及 kernel 优化实践

items.title: ysr666/dsh-vision-router
items.summary: Eyes for text-only DeepSeek Harness agents: built-in free vision chain (no key) + pixel-level vision tools (Q&A, grounding, crop, pixel diff, colors, OCR, SVG trace, cutout, screenshots). One-command install, no Python, image turns work like ordinary tool-calling turns.
items.summary_zh: dsh-vision-router 为 DeepSeek 文本 agent 提供免 key 视觉工具链，支持像素级视觉操作
items.why_zh: 属多模态 Agent 工程技能点，掌握如何将视觉能力封装为标准 tool-calling 接口

items.title: Progress-Aware Distillation for Mitigating Stagnation in Small Language Model Agents
items.summary: While LLM-based agent systems have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in reasoning and solving complex real-world tasks, they also come with substantial token consumption and inference latency, limiting their practical deployment. To enhance the efficiency of agent systems, recent efforts have focused on transferring agentic capabilities from large-scale models to small language models (SLMs) via supervised fine-tuning-based distillation. Nevertheless, as interaction trajectories grow longer, i
items.summary_zh: 提出进展感知蒸馏方法，缓解小模型 agent 训练停滞问题
items.why_zh: 属模型压缩与 agent 效率技能点，学习如何利用任务进展信号优化小模型 agentic 能力迁移

items.title: tap222/assay-evals
items.summary: Behavioral regression testing for AI apps and agents: pytest plugin, behavior diff, CI gate, and document extraction metrics
items.summary_zh: assay-evals 提供 AI agent 行为回归测试框架，含 pytest 插件与 CI 门禁
items.why_zh: 属 Agent 质量保障技能点，掌握如何构建可复用的 agent 行为 diff 测试与自动化评估流程

items.title: Lowaltitudeflight/local-llm-tuning-guide
items.summary: A decision library for running local LLMs on multi-GPU machines without NVLink: parallelism, communication, quantization, speculative decoding, KV cache. Every conclusion carries its evidence grade and reproducible conditions.
items.summary_zh: local-llm-tuning-guide 总结无 NVLink 多卡本地 LLM 调优决策库，含量化与推测解码策略
items.why_zh: 属分布式推理与部署技能点，学习在受限硬件上优化并行策略与通信开销的实战经验

items.title: CyberArena: Benchmarking AI Agents in Live Symmetric Attack-and-Defense Combat
items.summary: AI agents are demonstrating increasingly strong offensive and defensive cybersecurity capabilities in the real world. Current benchmarks mostly evaluate agents in isolation against static targets. Real cyber operations, however, are dynamic and coupled: security postures constantly change as attackers and defenders adapt to each other in real time. Static benchmarks quickly saturate and miss an agent's ability to attack and defend simultaneously under live pressure. To address this gap, we prese
items.summary_zh: CyberArena 基准测试 AI agent 在动态对抗场景中的攻防能力，突破静态基准局限
items.why_zh: 属 Agent 评估与红队技能点，学习如何设计动态耦合环境以真实评估 agent 安全攻防表现

items.title: WhatsApp's help pages hid LLM instructions: dont recommend a regulator
items.summary_zh: WhatsApp 帮助中心页面被曝隐藏了针对 LLM 的指令，内容涉及禁止推荐监管机构，引发关于 LLM 提示词工程与伦理的讨论。
items.why_zh: 提示词注入与防御：学习如何在生产环境中识别隐藏在网页元数据或文本中的恶意指令，掌握 Prompt 安全加固的实际案例。

items.title: alchaincyf/huashu-art-motion
items.summary: 艺术动画skill：35种艺术风格、9种解说语法，用代码让画动起来。
items.summary_zh: 开源项目 huashu-art-motion 提供 35 种艺术风格与 9 种解说语法的代码库，通过代码驱动实现静态图像的动态化动画效果。
items.why_zh: 代码生成与多媒体结合：探索利用 LLM 生成逻辑代码（如 CSS/JS/Canvas）来驱动视觉动效的技术路径，适合构建自动化创意工具链。

items.title: Let Your AI Agent Do ITS OWN Harness Engineering (Here's How)
items.summary: Harness engineering is how we make AI agents better over time: improving the rules, skills and memory around the model every time the agent gets something wrong. Most of us still do that by hand. In this video I show you how to let your agent do its own harness engineering, learning from real conversations and proposing changes to its own harness, while you stay in the driver's seat and approve everything it learns. It's the same playbook that makes coding agents reliable, applied to any agent y…
items.summary_zh: Cole Medin 介绍让 AI Agent 自主执行 Harness Engineering 的方法，Agent 从对话中总结错误并提议修改自身规则与技能，人类保留审批权。
items.why_zh: Agent 自我优化与元学习；掌握让模型反思失败案例并自动更新 Prompt 库、记忆模块的工程闭环设计。

items.title: Exa 3.0 Search API Tops Perplexity, Brave and Parallel on 8 Benchmarks
items.summary: Exa 3.0 is a search API upgrade from Exa. It adds a larger embedding model, Exa Lite at $4 per 1,000 requests, and Dynamic Highlights, and leads 8 benchmarks Exa ran itself. The post Exa 3.0 Search API Tops Perplexity, Brave and Parallel on 8 Benchmarks appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Exa 3.0 Search API 发布，集成更大嵌入模型、低价 Exa Lite 及 Dynamic Highlights，在 8 项基准测试中领先 Perplexity 等竞品。
items.why_zh: RAG 检索层优化：理解专用搜索 API 如何超越通用 LLM，学习利用动态摘要和低成本接口提升检索增强生成的效率与成本效益。

items.title: Do Diffusion LLMs Scale? Testing Mercury 3 + Decide
items.summary: Inception's Mercury 3 is a diffusion LLM running at 1,000+ tokens/sec, and Mercury Decide is a decision model that can now read images. Here's how they compare, what the independent evals say, and how fast they really are. Thanks to Inception for sponsoring this video. Links: Try Mercury Decide free on OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai/inception/mercury-decide:free Mercury 3 playground: https://chat.inceptionlabs.ai/ Inception API platform + docs: http://platform.inceptionlabs.ai/ Mercury 3 laun…
items.summary_zh: Sam Witteveen 测试 Inception 的 Mercury 3 扩散 LLM（1000+ tok/s）与 Mercury Decide 决策模型，对比其速度、独立评测表现及图像理解能力。
items.why_zh: 高性能 LLM 选型与基准测试；学习评估扩散模型在高吞吐场景下的延迟特性及多模态决策模型的实际效能。

items.title: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at 1,068 Tokens per Second
items.summary: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM it says runs at 1,068 tokens per second with a 1M-token context. On Inception’s own table it leads GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on 8 of 12 benchmarks. The post Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at 1,068 Tokens per Second appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Inception 发布 Mercury 3 扩散 LLM，宣称达 1,068 tokens/s 及 1M 上下文，在自测表中于 12 项基准中的 8 项领先 GPT-6 等模型。
items.why_zh: 长上下文与速度：关注扩散架构在处理百万级上下文时的吞吐能力，学习如何评估非传统 LLM 架构在推理延迟和成本上的实际表现。

items.title: 当Coding Agent开始动态并行，软件开发变得更好了吗？
items.summary: Coding Agent正在进入新的发展阶段。过去，它们主要修复Bug、解决GitHub Issue或实现相对独立的功能，SWE-bench等Benchmark已为此建立了成熟…
tokens: 软件开发变得更好了吗
items.summary_zh: 探讨 Coding Agent 进入动态并行阶段，突破过去修复 Bug 或独立功能的局限，分析其对软件开发效率及 SWE-bench 基准测试的影响。
items.why_zh: 涉及 Agent 架构演进与并行调度机制，帮助工程师理解多任务并发处理逻辑及评估大型语言模型在软件工程领域的实际落地能力。

items.title: Cooking with Codex: Ep. 1
items.summary: In this episode of Cooking with Codex, an OpenAI dot helps plan a ramen recipe and organize prep in ChatGPT Space, with GPT-Live guiding the cooking process. Also covered: Codex cloud environments, which keep tasks running after a laptop is closed, and new Codex CLI features including voice input, agent management, and forking conversations into separate worktrees. Matthew and Brian from Forward Future join to build an 8-bit ramen game using Ultrafast and play it on a ModRetro. Plus, a showcase …
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 Codex 演示视频，展示 GPT-Live 引导烹饪流程，介绍 Codex 云端环境保持任务运行及 CLI 支持语音输入、Agent 管理与多工作树分叉功能。
items.why_zh: 涵盖 Agent 环境持久化、人机交互优化及多分支任务管理，有助于掌握长时程 Agent 任务的状态保持与复杂工作流编排技巧。
